correctness.rationale: Strictly increasing levels force each mixed vertex to level two and its pure neighbors to the appropriate outer levels. Adjacent mixed vertices obstruct all maps. If they are independent, any independent set in the induced residual graph is a legal middle fibre there, and every legal assignment is obtained uniquely this way, with isolates and target-vertex choices contributing the stated factors. For p≠r the independence polynomial is evaluated with distinct vertex activities q/p and q/r on residual sources and sinks, not recovered from the ordinary univariate polynomial alone. Connectivity forces exactly two orientations without mixed vertices. In any other orientation with a legal map, adjoining arbitrary subsets of M to residual independent sets injects 2^|M| I_R(1) sets into I_G(1); the singleton of a neighbor of M is not in its image. The two-sided pendant tree realizes the ratio 1/[1+(1+2^(−N))²], which tends to 1/2 from below. On the n≥2 path, adjacent mixed vertices are equivalent to a run of three equal edge directions, giving 2F_n; each proper three-coloring determines a unique orientation, giving the total 3·2^(n−1). A separate bounded enumeration compared direct assignments of target vertices with subset counts for all 760 oriented-or-missing-edge inputs of order 1–4 at (1,1,1), (2,1,1), (1,2,2) and compared the 760 full middle-fibre coefficient vectors. It also checked 4750 orientations of 218 connected labelled bipartite graphs of order 2–5, all 510 path orientations of orders 2–9, and the pendant-tree counts for N=1–4. All matched.
residual_risks: The original VERIFY_OK 3473 is recorded evidence, not an independent run. The independent bounded census supplements, but does not replace, the bijective and extremal proofs.

value.rationale: The canonical reduction separates forced choices from a standard graph count and preserves all middle-fibre sizes. More importantly, the stability theorem quantifies how much is lost by introducing mixed vertices in a natural orientation problem, with a universal factor that is sharp even for trees. The Fibonacci and summed-coloring identities are illustrative consequences, not the basis of value.
residual_risks: An independence-polynomial evaluation is not an efficient counting algorithm for arbitrary inputs. The half-gap is for the strict unweighted three-vertex target and connected bipartite bases.
